title: InformationSystemService
description: A service provided by an information system or a software platform to a consumer, expressed as a contract about the exchange of capability, functionality or data. Specialises Core dea:Service per the kernel+specialization template (CR-MM-PROC-01 precedent for Process/BusinessProcess; CR-016 precedent for Capability/BusinessCapability; CR-018 precedent for Behavior/InformationSystemFunction; CR-019 precedent for SolutionComponent/InformationSystemComponent). The service contract is operationalised through integration interfaces (deferred to CR-021). Relationship connections (provision, usage, exposure, realises-business-service) are expressed via the canonical relationship vocabulary (dea:provides, dea:uses, dea:exposes, dea:realizes) and are not duplicated as inline relationship state on this entity, per CR-3.

external_references.description: CR-3P: identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEA id (E004).
